text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: That sure is a lot of monsters you took down! Good stuff!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなに魔物を倒すなんて、
やりますね～！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text:
I've still got plenty of room left, though. ♪
Should I go with sashimi next? Or maybe fry it up...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも私はまだまだ食べられますよ♪
次はお刺身かなぁ、
揚げ物かなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Seafood really is the best. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ、
やっぱり海の幸は最高ですね♪
